about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice B): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Embutido Filipino Baked Pork Meatloaf with Sweet Pickle
recipes.summary: A baked pork loaf with carrot, raisins and a boiled egg centre, sliced and served with rice.
steps: Boil 2 eggs for 9 minutes, cool and peel.
Mix the pork, carrot, raisins, breadcrumbs, remaining egg, soy sauce, pepper and 1/2 tsp salt.
Press half the mixture into a lined loaf tin, lay in the boiled eggs, then cover with the rest.
Bake at 180°C for 50 minutes until firm and browned, brushing with tomato sauce for the last 10.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, rest the loaf 10 minutes, slice and serve.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork loaf until it reaches 75°C in the centre, and hard-boil the eggs. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pochero Filipino Chicken and Banana Tomato Stew
recipes.summary: A mild tomato stew with chicken, chickpeas, potatoes and green beans served over rice.
steps: Fry the onion and garlic in the oil for 4 minutes, then brown the chicken for 6 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, fish sauce, potatoes, chickpeas and 1 cup water and simmer covered for 25 minutes until the potato is tender.
Add the beans for 5 minutes until just tender.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, and serve with the stew.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C near the bone. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Paksiw na Isda Filipino Vinegar-Poached Fish with Ginger
recipes.summary: White fish gently simmered with vinegar, ginger, garlic and green chilli, served with rice.

items: 700g white fish fillet, cut in pieces

steps: Layer the onion, ginger, garlic and chillies in a wide pan.
Add the fish, vinegar, 1/2 cup water, pepper and 1/2 tsp salt and bring to a boil without stirring until bubbling.
Simmer covered for 12 minutes until the fish is opaque and flakes.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, and serve with the fish and pan juices.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and it reaches 63°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Escabeche Filipino Sweet and Sour Fried Fish with Vegetables
recipes.summary: Crisp fried fish topped with a sweet-sour sauce of capsicum, carrot and ginger, served with rice.

items: 1 tbsp fresh ginger, cut in thin sticks

steps: Dust the fish in flour and salt, then fry 4 minutes each side until golden and cooked through.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Simmer the vinegar, sugar, ginger, carrot and 1/2 cup water for 4 minutes, then add the capsicum and cornflour mixed with 2 tbsp water, and stir until glossy.
Pour over the fish and serve with the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and it reaches 63°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Mechado Filipino Braised Beef in Tomato and Soy
recipes.summary: Beef braised until fall-apart with potatoes, carrots and a tangy tomato-soy sauce, served with rice.
steps: Brown the beef in the oil in batches for 10 minutes, then fry the onion and garlic for 4 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, soy sauce, lemon juice, bay leaf and 2 cups water and simmer covered for 1 hour 15 minutes until the beef is tender.
Add the potatoes and carrots and cook for 20 minutes until soft.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, and serve with the beef.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef until it reaches 75°C and is tender. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Waakye Ghanaian Rice and Beans with Egg and Tomato Stew
recipes.summary: Rice and black-eyed beans cooked together, served with boiled eggs and a spicy tomato stew.
steps: Simmer the rice and peas together with 2 cups water and 1/2 tsp salt covered for 18 minutes until tender.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool and peel.
Fry the onion and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes, add the tomatoes and chilli and cook for 15 minutes until thick.
Serve the rice and beans with the stew and halved eggs.
notes: Food safety: hard-boil the eggs until the yolk is firm. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Efo Riro Nigerian Spinach Stew with Chicken
recipes.summary: Chicken in a rich pepper and spinach stew with onions, served with rice.
steps: Blend the capsicums, tomatoes, half the onion and chilli powder.
Simmer the chicken in water with the remaining onion and salt for 20 minutes until cooked through.
Fry the blended sauce in the oil for 12 minutes until reduced and the oil rises.
Add the squeezed spinach, chicken and 1/2 cup stock and simmer for 5 minutes.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, and serve with the stew.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C near the bone. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Poulet DG Cameroonian Chicken with Plantain and Vegetables
recipes.summary: Pan-fried chicken in a tomato and herb sauce with fried plantain, carrots and green beans.
steps: Brown the chicken in 2 tbsp oil for 10 minutes, then remove.
Fry the onion, garlic and ginger in the same pan for 5 minutes, add the tomatoes and thyme and cook 8 minutes.
Return the chicken with 1 cup water and the carrots and simmer covered for 20 minutes until cooked through, adding the beans for 5.
Fry the plantain in the remaining oil for 3 minutes each side until golden, and serve on the side.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C near the bone. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Domoda Gambian Peanut Butter Stew with Sweet Potato and Rice
recipes.summary: A smooth peanut and tomato stew with chicken and sweet potato, served with rice.
steps: Fry the onion and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes, add the chicken and brown 5 minutes.
Stir the peanut butter and tomato paste into 3 cups water and add with the sweet potato and 1/2 tsp salt.
Simmer for 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce thick.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, and serve with the stew.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C. Contains peanuts. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Durban Chicken Curry with Potatoes and Roti
recipes.summary: A fragrant Durban-style chicken curry with potato, served with flatbread.
steps: Fry the onions in the oil for 8 minutes, add the garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and chicken and cook 8 minutes, then add the potatoes and 1 cup water.
Simmer covered 25 minutes until the chicken is cooked and the potato tender.
Warm the flatbreads and serve with the curry.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C near the bone. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pap en Wors South African Maize Porridge with Sausage and Tomato Relish
recipes.summary: Grilled sausages with soft polenta-style pap and a quick tomato and onion gravy.
steps: Bring 4 cups water and 1/2 tsp salt to a boil and whisk in the polenta, then cook on low for 20 minutes until thick, stirring often.
Fry the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, add the tomatoes, paste and sugar and simmer for 10 minutes until saucy.
Grill or pan-fry the sausages for 12 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through.
Serve the sausages on the pap with the relish.
notes: Food safety: cook the sausages until they reach 75°C in the centre. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Mishkaki Swahili Marinated Beef Skewers with Coconut Rice
recipes.summary: Tender beef skewers marinated with garlic, lemon and paprika, grilled and served with coconut rice.
steps: Mix the beef with the garlic, ginger, lemon juice, spices, oil and 1 tsp salt.
Cook the rice with the coconut milk and 1 cup water until tender and fluffy.
Thread the beef onto skewers and grill for 10 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Serve with the coconut rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef until it reaches 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Firfir Ethiopian Shredded Injera in Spiced Beef Sauce
recipes.summary: Torn flatbread soaked in a spicy beef and tomato sauce, a hearty Ethiopian breakfast-or-dinner plate.
steps: Cook the onions dry for 8 minutes, add the oil, garlic, ginger and spices and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the beef, tomatoes and 1 cup water and simmer covered for 30 minutes until the beef is tender.
Fold the torn flatbread through for 2 minutes until it absorbs the sauce.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef until it reaches 75°C and is tender. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Beef Sambusa Somali Spiced Pastry Pockets with Lime Yoghurt
recipes.summary: Crisp baked pastry triangles filled with spiced beef, onion and coriander.
steps: Fry the onion, garlic and beef in 1 tbsp oil for 10 minutes until cooked through, then add the spices, salt and coriander and cool.
Fold the wrappers around a spoonful of filling into triangles, sealing with water.
Brush with the remaining oil and bake at 200°C for 15 minutes until crisp and golden.
Stir lime juice into the yoghurt and serve alongside.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef filling until it reaches 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Kenyan Grilled Tilapia-Style Fish with Tomato Salsa and Ugali
recipes.summary: Whole-style white fish grilled with chilli and lemon, served with a tomato and onion salsa and maize porridge.
steps: Rub the fish with the lemon juice, garlic, chilli, oil and 1/2 tsp salt.
Bring 3 cups water to a boil, whisk in the polenta and stir over low heat for 15 minutes until thick and stiff.
Grill the fish for 4 minutes each side until opaque and flaking.
Mix the tomatoes, onion and a pinch of salt for the salsa and serve all together.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and it reaches 63°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Ethiopian Fasting Plate with Gomen Greens and Spiced Lentils
recipes.summary: A vegan Ethiopian plate of collard-style greens and spiced red lentils with flatbread.
steps: Cook one onion dry for 6 minutes, add 1 tbsp oil, garlic, paprika and turmeric for 1 minute.
Add the lentils and 3 cups water and simmer 20 minutes until soft and thick.
Soften the other onion and ginger in the remaining oil for 5 minutes, add the silverbeet and 1/2 cup water and cook for 12 minutes until tender.
Serve both with the flatbreads.

recipes.title: Laulau Hawaiian Pork and Silverbeet Parcels with Rice
recipes.summary: Pork wrapped in silverbeet leaves and steamed slowly until silky, served with rice.
steps: Mix the pork with the soy sauce, salt and ginger.
Wrap a portion of pork in 2 silverbeet leaves, then in foil, making 4 parcels.
Steam for 1 hour 45 minutes until the pork is tender and the leaves soft.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, and serve with the opened parcels.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C and is tender. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Kalbi Short Ribs with Pineapple Rice
recipes.summary: Thin sliced beef short ribs in a sweet soy, garlic and pineapple marinade, grilled until caramelised.
steps: Mix the soy sauce, sugar, juice, garlic and sesame oil, and coat the ribs.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, then fold through the pineapple.
Grill the ribs over high heat for 3 minutes each side until charred and cooked through.
Serve the ribs with the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef until it reaches 75°C. Boil any marinade used on raw meat before serving. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Sapasui Samoan Chicken and Glass Noodle Stir-Fry
recipes.summary: A comforting Samoan noodle dish with chicken, carrot and soy, a family favourite.
steps: Soak the noodles until soft, then drain and cut shorter.
Fry the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil for 4 minutes, add the chicken and cook for 6 minutes until cooked through.
Add the carrots, soy sauce and 1 cup water and simmer for 5 minutes until the carrots are tender.
Toss the noodles through for 2 minutes until they absorb the sauce.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Puaka Tunu Tongan Roast Pork with Coconut Sweet Potato
recipes.summary: Slow-roasted pork shoulder with garlic and salt, served with sweet potato simmered in coconut milk.
steps: Rub the pork with the garlic and 2 tsp salt and roast at 160°C for 1 hour 30 minutes until tender, then rest for 10 minutes.
Simmer the sweet potato, onion, coconut milk and 1/2 cup water for 25 minutes until the sweet potato is soft.
Slice the pork and serve with the sweet potato.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C and is tender. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Manapua Hawaiian Steamed Char Siu Pork Buns
recipes.summary: Soft steamed buns stuffed with sticky sweet roast pork, a Hawaiian plate-lunch classic.
steps: Knead the flour, yeast, sugar and 3/4 cup warm water, then rise for 1 hour until doubled.
Brown the pork in the oil for 6 minutes, add the hoisin, soy sauce, honey and 1/3 cup water and simmer 25 minutes until tender.
Stir the cornflour with 1 tbsp water in and simmer until thick, then cool.
Divide the dough into 8, fill and seal.
Steam for 15 minutes until puffed and firm.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.
